title: Devops Engineer
description:
Role: DevOps Engineer Location: Bhubaneswar + What are we looking for? We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with 4-6 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, CI/CD, and monitoring solutions. The ideal candidate will manage cloud deployments, Kubernetes orchestration, application monitoring, and automated pipelines, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. Knowledge of AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Ingress, gateway governance, ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana is essential. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about solving real-world problems using cutting-edge technologies and working on high-scale, high-throughput systems. 
 Education: BTech in CSE, EC, IT 
 Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in deploying, managing, and maintaining real-world applications on AWS or Azure. Experience working on real-world projects during professional roles or internships 
 Technical Expertise: Hands-on expertise with AWS and Azure cloud platforms. Strong experience with Kubernetes deployment, scaling, and management. Knowledge of Ingress, API gateway configuration, and gateway governance. Experience with Docker and containerized microservices architecture. Experience with automated testing and quality monitoring in CI/CD pipelines. Strong incident response, logging, and alerting experience 
 Frameworks & Tools: Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). Experience with monitoring and logging tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack. Strong scripting skills (Shell, Python, or PowerShell). Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible). Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd). Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible (preferred). 
 Additional Knowledge: Understanding of cloud security best practices and Kubernetes security. Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments and hybrid cloud architectures. 
 Preferred Qualification: Participation in hackathons. Contributions to GitHub repositories, technical blogs, or open-source projects are an added advantage. 
 Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Structured thinking and cognitive skills. Good presentation and communication skills. High energy, curiosity, and willingness to learn. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team environment. 
 + You would be responsible for Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure. Implement Kubernetes clusters, deployments, and scaling strategies, including managing Ingress and API gateways. Define and enforce gateway governance policies for secure API access and routing. Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to automate application deployment and testing. Monitor application and infrastructure performance using Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation). Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to streamline deployment and release processes. Ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications and infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents and performance issues. Mentor junior DevOps engineers and promote best practices in deployment, monitoring, and security

Key Skills: Docker,Ci/Cd,Kubernetes,AWS DevOps,CI CD Pipeline,Eks,AWS,Devops
